headline: Google's charity arm, Google.org, is giving $36 million to 17 organizations that use AI for science in areas such as climate, health and energy.
score_reason: Pool score 5 kept: an official award of real size, but it is a company's own announcement of grants.
summary: Google.org, Google's philanthropic arm, announced on its blog that 17 organizations from a field of applicants in 30 countries will share $36 million through its Impact Challenge: AI for Science. The recipients can also join a six-month accelerator with engineering support, mentoring and Google infrastructure.
importance_line: Research groups working on climate, health and fusion energy gain funding and Google's support, though what each team will deliver is not stated and the announcement is Google's own.
notes: Official Google announcement; tone is promotional, summary kept to the stated facts.
